records.title: Improving the RAG-based Personalized Discharge Care System by Introducing the Memory Mechanism
records.reason: This paper applies RAG/memory to a personalized discharge-care application and evaluates advice quality; no general inference-efficiency method is established.

records.title: The Imperative of Conversation Analysis in the Era of LLMs: A Survey of Tasks, Techniques, and Trends
records.reason: The survey organizes conversation-analysis tasks and techniques; LLMs are discussed as a field trend, not as an inference/serving optimization target.

records.title: Understanding Performance Implications of LLM Inference on CPUs
records.reason: Because the primary full paper could not be retrieved, detailed workload tables, methods and reproducibility are not verified; borderline pending full text.

records.title: MicroBERT: Distilling MoE-Based Knowledge from BERT into a Lighter Model
records.reason: MicroBERT distills BERT for resource-constrained NLP and evaluates GLUE task quality; the abstract does not establish generative LLM inference/serving results.

records.title: ChatLogic: Integrating Logic Programming with Large Language Models for Multi-Step Reasoning
records.reason: ChatLogic combines LLMs with logic programming to improve multi-step reasoning capability; no inference-time efficiency outcome is reported.
